compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD6: unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic (RED phase — tests must FAIL before implementation)

## Implementation
Create a new unit test file `tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-response-defend.sh` with 5 behavioral unit tests for the `_handle_defend` function in `pr-comment-response.sh`. Follow the `_make_stub_dir` pattern from `tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh` for stubbing `gh`.

NOTE: Use a SEPARATE test file from the defer story's `tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-response.sh` to avoid git merge conflicts when stories are dispatched in parallel worktrees.

**Test approach (Given/When/Then):**

Test 1: `test_defend_posts_review_comment_and_writes_defense_comment_id`
- Given: normalized JSON with comment-200 (defend, is_inline=true, path="src/foo.sh"), gh stub returns JSON {"id":9001} for inline reply endpoint, dummy defense argument in JSON
- When: pr-comment-response.sh --classify-as "comment-200:defend" runs
- Then: gh was called with POST to .../pulls/{n}/comments/{root}/replies; defense_comment_id in output JSON equals "9001"; a second gh call (thread reply) was also made

Test 2: `test_defend_top_level_uses_issues_endpoint`
- Given: comment-200 with is_inline=false (top-level review comment)
- When: handler runs
- Then: gh was called with POST to .../issues/{n}/comments (not the pulls/comments path); defense_comment_id written to JSON

Test 3: `test_defend_retry_skips_review_comment_when_defense_id_present`
- Given: comment-200 where defense_comment_id is already set to "existing-9001" in the JSON
- When: pr-comment-response.sh --classify-as "comment-200:defend" runs
- Then: no POST to the review comment endpoint (gh call log does NOT contain the review comment POST); thread reply IS posted; defense_comment_id remains "existing-9001"

Test 4: `test_defend_422_fallback_uses_issues_endpoint`
- Given: gh stub exits 1 (simulating 422) for the inline endpoint; is_inline=true
- When: handler runs
- Then: gh call falls back to .../issues/{n}/comments; defense_comment_id is written; script does not fail

Test 5: `test_defend_reply_body_includes_sentinel_and_defense_comment_id`
- Given: normal inline setup; gh stub returns {"id":9001} for the review comment call
- When: handler runs end-to-end
- Then: the thread reply gh call body contains "<!-- dso-agent-reply -->" and "9001" (the defense comment ID)

**Stub pattern**: Use `_make_stub_dir` to create temp dir. The `gh` stub must:
- Record calls to $GH_CALL_LOG (append method + path + body per call)
- Return JSON `{"id":9001}` for the review comment POST
- Return success for thread replies
- For the 422 test: stub exits 1 for the inline endpoint only; success for /issues endpoint

**RED marker required**: Add to `.test-index`:
```
plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh:tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-response-defend.sh [test_defend_posts_review_comment_and_writes_defense_comment_id]
```

## File Impact

| `.test-index` | Edit (add RED marker) |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-response-defend.sh` exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-response-defend.sh
- [ ] File contains 5 test functions starting with test_defend_
  Verify: grep -c '^test_defend_' tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-response-defend.sh | grep -qx 5
- [ ] Tests fail RED (at least 1 FAILED) before _handle_defend implementation
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-response-defend.sh 2>/dev/null; [ $? -ne 0 ]
- [ ] .test-index has RED marker for test_defend_posts_review_comment_and_writes_defense_comment_id
  Verify: grep -q 'test_defend_posts_review_comment_and_writes_defense_comment_id' .test-index
- [ ] No real api.github.com calls escape (mock enforced)
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
